title: ProsSegue manually segmented NURC-SP reference TextGrids
why_promising: ProsSegue explicitly separates manually segmented reference TextGrids from UFPAlign forced-alignment and automatic prosodic outputs. This is a potentially admissible secondary-recording case because the project contributes a genuinely new, isolatable human annotation layer for Brazilian Portuguese spontaneous speech; SP_D2_255.TextGrid is publicly accessible and contains nine tiers.
open_question: Establish exactly which tiers in each reference TextGrid were created by the expert manual prosodic segmentation rather than inherited transcript/UFPAlign material, enumerate all inquiries with reference TextGrids, and verify the licensing/provenance scope for derived annotations from NURC-SP before core promotion. Admit only demonstrably manual sentence/stressed-group/prosodic-reference layers; exclude forced-aligned phone/word tiers and model outputs.
